2607.05369.title: GaP: A Graph-as-Policy Multi-Agent Self-Learning Harness For Variational Automation Tasks
2607.05369.paper_summary: For robots to work reliably in commercial and industrial applications, can recent advances in agentic coding systems combine interpretable robot programming with the open-world adaptability of model-free policies? We focus on "Variational Automation" (VA), a class of tasks that have larger variations in object geometry and pose than fixed automation. Model-free policies often struggle to close the reliability gap for VA tasks, which must be executed persistently and reliably in commercial and industrial applications. Motivated by prior work on Task and Motion Planning (TAMP) and the Robot Operating System (ROS), we introduce Graph-as-Policy (GaP), a multi-agent coding harness that generates directed computation graphs with perception, planning, and control nodes from a Modular Open Robot Skill Library (MORSL). GaP then generates an internal simulation environment to rehearse task instances with different graphs in parallel to iteratively refine the graph structure and parameters to improve success rates and throughput. Evaluation with 8 new open VA task benchmarks, 4 in-simulation and 4 in real-world, suggests that GaP can achieve success rates that significantly outperform baselines. Details, code, and data can be found online: https://graph-robots.github.io/gap
2607.05369.paper_summary_zh: 為了讓機器人在商業和工業應用中可靠地運作，最近在代理編碼系統方面的進展能否將可解釋的機器人編程與無模型策略的開放世界適應性相結合？我們專注於「變分自動化」（VA），這是一類在物體幾何形狀和姿勢上變化較大的任務，超過了固定自動化。無模型策略通常難以縮小VA任務的可靠性差距，這些任務必須在商業和工業應用中持續且可靠地執行。受到先前在任務與運動規劃（TAMP）和機器人操作系統（ROS）方面工作的啟發，我們介紹了Graph-as-Policy（GaP），這是一種多代理編碼工具，能從模組化開放機器人技能庫（MORSL）生成具有感知、規劃和控制節點的有向計算圖。然後，GaP生成一個內部模擬環境，以平行排練不同圖的任務實例，並迭代地完善圖的結構和參數，以提高成功率和吞吐量。對8個新的開放VA任務基準的評估，4個在模擬中，4個在現實世界中，表明GaP能夠實現顯著超越基準的成功率。詳細信息、代碼和數據可以在以下網址找到：https://graph-robots.github.io/gap
